_doc: The Cordon wall (wall panels, the Route 9 gate, the river gate bays and abutments, the Program notice board). Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_cordon_wall.py. Textures: tools/assetgen/textures/gen/cordon.py: cordon_print is an atlas (UV rects in the generator's ATLAS: primer patches with sprayed stencils, so a band reads on the bare concrete), cordon_concrete tiles precast concrete at 2 m per tile (the generator maps concrete at uv_scale 0.5 per metre). cw_concrete_wet is the same concrete darkened under the waterline. Shared ids reused: ws_* (the Waystation kit's paints, hazard, sandbags, flood glow), farm_corrugated_galv / _rust, road_concrete, road_steel, road_plywood, wood_weathered, lens_clear, rubber_black, plastic_black, trap_chain, trap_brass, cardboard, w3_log_bark.
